description: Main backend server implementation for Subtitle Sync Platform. Handles file uploads for subtitle correction and generation workflows, setups database session management, and defines API endpoints using FastAPI.

methods.name: get_db()
methods.description: Creates and manages database session lifecycle, providing a session for dependency injection.

methods.name: correction_upload( video_file: UploadFile = File(..., description="Video file for subtitle correction."), subtitle_file: UploadFile = File(..., description="Subtitle file to be checked and corrected."), )
methods.description: API endpoint to receive a video and subtitle file for correction, saves files, and queues correction workflow.

methods.name: generation_upload( video_file: UploadFile = File(..., description="Video file for generating subtitles."), language: str = Form(..., description="Output subtitle language (ISO code, e.g., 'en', 'es')."), )
methods.description: API endpoint to receive a video and target language for subtitle generation, saves files, and queues generation workflow.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: A simple endpoint to confirm the backend is operational.

methods.name: custom_openapi()
methods.description: Serves the OpenAPI schema for API documentation.

methods.name: startup_event()
methods.description: Event handler to initialize the database on server startup.

methods.name: placeholder_llm_integration(*args, **kwargs)
methods.description: Placeholder function for future Large Language Model integration logic.

methods.name: Path save_upload_file(upload_file: UploadFile, subdir: Path, filename: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Utility function to save an uploaded file to disk and return its path.
